evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/c masks rotation with 3 and maps local x/y through the four canonical 8x8 chunk rotations, including 7-coordinate inversion for 180/270 degree cases.
Its two five-argument helpers additionally subtract width/height minus one under rotated orientations, matching placement of rectangular object footprints inside an 8x8 map chunk.
The class is final/package-private, owns no fields or mutable state, and consists entirely of the four coordinate-rotation helpers.

candidates.note: Conservative descriptive name for the exact 8x8 map-chunk coordinate rotation utility. No lost original source class name is claimed.
